info.title: Kriraghor API
info.description: REST API for kriraghor.com, esports.kriraghor.com, the admin and vendor portals and the mobile app. Errors are RFC 7807 problem details with a stable `code`. Generated from the zod schemas; do not edit openapi.json by hand.

PublicSettings.description: Public settings grouped by prefix with camelCase names; money as { amount, currency }. Includes a `version` stamp.

PayoutReveal.description: The full wallet number, for sending this payout by hand. Audited; never stored or logged; do not cache.

sameWalletUsers.description: Other users with this wallet (pending or active)
